name: WF-03 Conversation & Context State v4 — Persistent Context

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id conversation_id,c.customer_id,c.channel,c.turn_count,c.automated_turn_count,
c.escalation_status,cc.* FROM public.conversations c
JOIN public.conversation_context cc ON cc.conversation_id=c.id
WHERE c.id=$1 AND c.customer_id=$2 LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode:
const inp=$('Validate Context Input').first().json, rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json), s=rows[0]||{};
return [{json:{...s,conversation_id:inp.conversation_id,customer_id:inp.customer_id,turn_id:inp.turn_id,current_message:inp.message,proposed:inp.proposed||null,commerce_status:inp.commerce_status||s.commerce_status||'unknown',source_of_truth:inp.source_of_truth||s.source_of_truth||'kb_only',context_loaded:Boolean(rows.length)}}];

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.conversation_context SET language=$3,script=$4,register=$5,intent=$6,sub_intent=$7,
sales_stage=$8,selected_products=$9::jsonb,purchase_intent=$10::jsonb,next_required_fields=$11::jsonb,
commerce_status=$12,source_of_truth=$13,last_message_hash=encode(digest($14,'sha256'),'hex'),
last_customer_message=$14,version=version+1,last_updated=now()
WHERE conversation_id=$1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations c WHERE c.id=$1 AND c.customer_id=$2)
RETURNING *;

parameters.jsCode:
const x=$('Build Allowlisted State Update').first().json;
return [{json:{customer_id:x.customer_id,conversation_id:x.conversation_id,turn_id:x.turn_id,context_loaded:x.context_loaded,persisted:true,language:x.next_state.language,script:x.next_state.script,register:x.next_state.register,intent:x.next_state.intent,sub_intent:x.next_state.sub_intent,sales_stage:x.next_state.sales_stage,identity_level:Number(x.identity_level||0),selected_products:x.next_state.selected_products,purchase_intent:x.next_state.purchase_intent,customer_details:x.next_state.purchase_intent?.customer_details||{},next_required_fields:x.next_state.next_required_fields,commerce_status:x.commerce_status,source_of_truth:x.source_of_truth}}];
